en.title: K Smallest Substring
en.description:
In a string consisting only of 0/1, choose a substring that contains exactly k ones; first minimize the length, and among equal lengths take the lexicographically smallest. The statement guarantees that an answer exists.

See the statement/review record for the problem source and the basis of the rules; limits marked in the input ranges are supplements added by this site.
en.input: The first line contains the binary string s; the second line contains the integer k. This site follows the original length range 1≤k≤|s|≤1000, and explicitly adds the statement's guarantee that 1≤k≤(the total number of 1s in s).
en.output: Output the valid substring that is smallest by (length, lexicographic order).
en.explanation: Process the input according to the problem rules; see the companion notes for the full approach, the correctness argument and the complexity.
hints: Using the indices of the 1s in the string, enumerate every group of k consecutive 1s, take the shortest substring covering those 1s, and compare by length and then lexicographically.
